items.title: 52145_Andrew Blakeney oral history interview
items.q: I got with Harry Southern, with the open air dance.

ctx.x: During this time--you mentioned San Bernadino, musicians making trips from San Bernadino to Los Angeles. Did the musicians play much in areas like San Luis, or Santa Barbara or up the coast during that time?
Not during that time, later on they did.

In San Bernadino we had kind of circuit up there; we lived up there. We played San Bernadino on Saturday night, the weekend; we'd go up to Hemet, down to Pomona, Riverside and around like that. That was during the summer of 1927 with Johnny Mitchell. I did that with him up until July and then I got with Harry Southern, with the open air dance.
